course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice saying the same request casually and semi-formally.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A person needs to ask a friend and a service desk about changing a time.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Adapting a request to the relationship and situation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare how to ask a friend versus a reception or service desk to move an appointment time.

main_focus.name: register shift in requests with kan, skulle kunna, and vore det möjligt
main_focus.description: Use direct, polite, and more semi-formal request frames for the same practical need.
model_examples: Kan vi flytta tiden till senare?
Skulle det vara möjligt att boka om tiden?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-5 request frames across casual and semi-formal versions of the same request.

vocabulary_target.theme: changing an appointment with the right tone
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use request chunks in pairs that show casual and semi-formal alternatives.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker needs to change a time and asks how polite the wording should be.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare a casual version with a semi-formal version and discuss which fits the situation.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the wording and add a brief reason or thanks.

target_complexity.repetition: reuse the same request content in different registers

focus: the contrast between casual and semi-formal wording
which wording fits the situation and why

sentence_focus: one casual request with Kan vi
one polite request with Skulle det vara möjligt att
one sentence explaining that a time does not fit
one sentence confirming the changed appointment
